title: 95-year-old widow faces £1m legal bill after losing appeal in decade-long fence dispute
summary_full: A 95-year-old widow is liable for over £1 million in legal fees following a lengthy dispute with her neighbours. Margaret Kinnear contested the boundary line concerning a small plot of land in Kent. Despite winning a trespass claim, she must cover her own legal expenses after the court's decision. The High Court dismissed her appeal, stating the original judge's ruling was valid and justified.
